scientific_integrity: Two independent exact-integer algorithms on every frequency, a full 34-orbit table, and Parseval and projection-kernel checks; independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite complete classification at five vertices; no assertion for all larger vertex counts; no historical-priority guarantee beyond bounded primary and record comparisons; sharp norm is of orthogonal range projection, not a universal projection minimum.
title: First nontrivial Walsh cancellation of the triangle-free graph property: a complete five-vertex spectrum
